___comment: Dedicated fixture dir (NOT the shared tests/harness/fixtures/llm/ pool): every fixture in the loaded dir is consulted on EVERY llm.generate()/debate()/research() call (packages/agent-harness-core/src/mock-llm.ts), so this file must not compete with council.json/ideal.json for other specs. Since b014c9b9 `/council` runs as a durable BACKGROUND council (orchestrator.ts runCouncilV2 orchestrator branch -> src/index.ts council delegation with skipClarification + skipPil + suppressPreDebateCards), so the old positional SEQUENCE - ordered for the foreground flow's clarifier/scope-research/spec-synthesis calls - no longer lines up: in the background flow the debate planner received the wrong entry and fell back to generic stances. This fixture therefore uses order-independent `responses` keyed on prompt substrings.

model.___comment: AI-SDK-level block. --mock-llm <dir> refuses to boot (exit 78) unless some file in the dir declares a {model:...} block (src/index.ts). `classify` answers the PIL classify call. The stream is main's turn when the host delivers the finished council result and wakes it.

stream.delta: Council result received; reviewing its implementation plan.

responses.text: {"intentSummary":"Add an E2E harness spec proving the council intent gate renders before any debate spend.","stances":[{"name":"Primary Engineer","lens":"Drive the real launch-card flow through the mock LLM deterministically."},{"name":"Skeptical Reviewer","lens":"Stress-test whether the assertion would actually catch a regression in the intent gate."}],"outputShape":{"kind":"implementation_plan","sections":[{"key":"steps","heading":"Steps","prompt":"ordered implementation steps","shape":"list"}],"guardrails":["Keep the spec deterministic — no live network calls."]}}
responses.___comment: planDebate's RETRY attempt (src/council/debate-planner.ts: retryPrompt = prompt + 'Schema validation failed: ...'). Attempt 1 always fails here: it calls generateObject directly against the AI-SDK mock, whose doGenerate defaults to '{}' with no 'generate' field configured on the model block above, and '{}' fails DebatePlanSchema validation. outputShape.kind='implementation_plan' is the leader's proposed intent the spec asserts the background council adopts.

responses.text: Council acknowledged - generic fallback for any remaining calls.
responses.___comment: Every other council call (panel select, spec inference, research need, debate turns, synthesis). Each fails open on non-JSON text by design, so the debate still runs to a synthesis.
